name: Junior frontend, aliases and a title that understates the level
job_text:
Frontend Developer (Graduate)
Halcyon Studio — Remote

We build interfaces for museums and galleries. This is a first professional role: we expect you to have finished a degree or a bootcamp, and nothing more.

The role:
- Build screens from designs our team produces
- Fix bugs reported by our support team
- Learn our codebase with the support of a senior developer

Requirements:
- A degree in computer science or an equivalent bootcamp
- JS fundamentals
- Some React.js
- English, written and spoken

Bonus points:
- TS
- Any experience with accessibility standards

We do not expect commercial experience. You will be paired with a senior developer for your first six months.
